name: Kawasaki KLR650 (1987-2007)
engine: 651 cc liquid-cooled DOHC single, one carb, balancer shaft
intro: The first-generation KLR. Tough and simple. Upgrade the 'doohickey' balancer tensioner before it fails.

add.title: Replace the doohickey and spring
add.instructions: Fit an upgraded balancer chain idler lever and torsion spring, then set the balancer chain tension.
add.reason: The stock welded lever and spring can break, the balancer chain goes slack, and the engine can be destroyed.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Doohickey
known.what: The balancer chain tensioner lever and spring are prone to failure on 1987-2007 KLRs.
